#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with the title 'Annual Financial Report' and the current date.

Transforms only report.pdf: builds a one-page cover (title + current date),
prepends it to the original pages, atomically replaces report.pdf, then
validates that page 1 contains the exact title and current date.
"""
import datetime
import os
import sys
import tempfile

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas


def find_report_pdf():
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(os.getcwd()):
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith(".")]
        if "report.pdf" in files:
            return os.path.join(root, "report.pdf")
    return None


def main():
    target = find_report_pdf()
    if target is None:
        sys.exit(f"ERROR: report.pdf not found under {os.getcwd()}")
    print(f"Target: {target}")

    reader = PdfReader(target)
    original_pages = len(reader.pages)
    print(f"Original page count: {original_pages}")

    today = datetime.date.today()
    date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    print(f"Current date: {date_str}")

    # 1) Build the cover page (letter size) with title and current date.
    workdir = os.path.dirname(target) or "."
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
        suffix=".pdf", prefix="cover_", dir=workdir, delete=False
    ) as tf:
        cover_path = tf.name

    c = canvas.Canvas(cover_path, pagesize=letter)
    width, height = letter
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height - 250, "Annual Financial Report")
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height - 290, date_str)
    c.save()

    # 2) Prepend the cover page to the original report pages.
    cover_reader = PdfReader(cover_path)
    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
        suffix=".pdf", prefix="report_with_cover_", dir=workdir, delete=False
    ) as tf:
        out_tmp = tf.name

    with open(out_tmp, "wb") as fh:
        writer.write(fh)

    # 3) Atomically replace report.pdf with the cover-page version.
    os.replace(out_tmp, target)
    os.remove(cover_path)

    # 4) Validate the result.
    check = PdfReader(target)
    page_count = len(check.pages)
    print(f"Updated page count: {page_count} (expected {original_pages + 1})")
    if page_count != original_pages + 1:
        sys.exit("ERROR: page count did not increase by exactly one")

    text = check.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    if "Annual Financial Report" not in text:
        sys.exit("ERROR: title 'Annual Financial Report' not found on cover page")
    if date_str not in text:
        sys.exit(f"ERROR: date {date_str!r} not found on cover page")

    print("VALIDATION OK: page 1 contains the exact title and current date")
    print("--- Page 1 text ---")
    print(text.strip())
    print("--------------------")
    total_text = "".join((p.extract_text() or "") for p in check.pages)
    print(f"Total extracted characters across all pages: {len(total_text)}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"

def esc_pdf_string(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def build_pdf(objects, root_ref, size):
    """Serialize object bodies (1-based) into a valid PDF with an xref table."""
    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = []
    for i, body in enumerate(objects, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += ("%d 0 obj\n" % i).encode("ascii") + body + b"\nendobj\n"
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += ("xref\n0 %d\n" % (size + 1)).encode("ascii")
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for off in offsets:
        out += ("%010d 00000 n \n" % off).encode("ascii")
    out += ("trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root %d 0 R >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n"
            % (size, root_ref, xref_pos)).encode("ascii")
    return bytes(out)


def make_cover_pdf(path, title, date_str):

    stream = (
        "BT\n"
        "/F1 30 Tf\n"

        "/F2 16 Tf\n"

        "(%s) Tj\n"
        "ET\n" % (esc_pdf_string(title), esc_pdf_string(date_str))
    ).encode("latin-1")

         b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R /F2 5 0 R >> >> /Contents 6 0 R >>"),
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>",
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        b"<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n" % len(stream) + stream + b"\nendstream",
    ]

        fh.write(build_pdf(objects, root_ref=1, size=len(objects)))


def create_cover_page(path):

    date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    try:

        from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

        width, height = letter
        c = canvas.Canvas(path, pagesize=letter)
        cx = width / 2.0
        c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)

    except ImportError:
        pass

    make_cover_pdf(path, TITLE, date_str)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pure-Python PDF parsing helpers
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def scan_objects(data):
    """Map object number -> (start, end) byte spans. Last definition wins."""
    spans = {}
    for m in re.finditer(rb"(?m)^\s*(\d+)\s+0\s+obj", data):
        num = int(m.group(1))
        start = m.start()
        end = data.find(b"endobj", start)
        if end == -1:
            continue
        spans[num] = (start, end + len(b"endobj"))
    return spans


def find_dict(data, pos):
    """Return the byte span of the << ... >> dict starting at/after pos."""
    i = data.find(b"<<", pos)
    if i == -1:
        return None
    depth = 0
    j = i
    while j < len(data):
        if data[j:j + 2] == b"<<":
            depth += 1
            j += 2
        elif data[j:j + 2] == b">>":
            depth -= 1
            j += 2
            if depth == 0:
                return i, j
        else:
            j += 1
    return None


def find_array(data, pos):
    """Return the byte span of the [ ... ] array starting at/after pos."""
    i = data.find(b"[", pos)
    if i == -1:
        return None
    depth = 0
    j = i
    while j < len(data):
        ch = data[j:j + 1]
        if ch == b"[":
            depth += 1
        elif ch == b"]":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return i, j + 1
        j += 1
    return None


def get_object_body(data, spans, num):
    start, end = spans[num]
    body = data[start:end]
    m = re.search(rb"^(\d+)\s+0\s+obj(.*?)endobj\s*$", body, re.S)
    return m.group(2) if m else body


def parse_page_tree_count(data, spans):
    """Count /Type /Page leaves reachable from the trailer's /Root."""
    trailer = find_dict(data, data.rfind(b"trailer"))
    if not trailer:
        raise RuntimeError("cannot find trailer")
    tdict = data[trailer[0]:trailer[1]]
    m = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", tdict)
    if not m:
        raise RuntimeError("cannot find /Root in trailer")
    root = int(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(rb"/Pages\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", get_object_body(data, spans, root))
    if not m:
        raise RuntimeError("cannot find /Pages in catalog")
    pages_root = int(m.group(1))

    def count(node):
        body = get_object_body(data, spans, node)
        if re.search(rb"/Type\s*/Page\b", body) and not re.search(rb"/Type\s*/Pages\b", body):
            return 1
        arr = find_array(body, body.find(b"/Kids"))
        if not arr:
            return 1
        kids = re.findall(rb"(\d+)\s+0\s+R", data[arr[0]:arr[1]])
        return sum(count(int(k)) for k in kids)

    return count(pages_root)


def pure_merge_cover(cover_path, report_path, out_path):
    """Prepend the cover page to report.pdf by object-level merging."""
    report = open(report_path, "rb").read()
    spans = scan_objects(report)
    if not spans:
        raise RuntimeError("could not parse objects of report.pdf")

    # /Encrypt is unsupported.
    trailer = find_dict(report, report.rfind(b"trailer"))
    if trailer and b"/Encrypt" in report[trailer[0]:trailer[1]]:
        raise RuntimeError("encrypted report.pdf is not supported")

    tdict = report[trailer[0]:trailer[1]]
    m = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", tdict)
    root = int(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(rb"/Pages\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", get_object_body(report, spans, root))
    pages_ref = int(m.group(1))
    pages_body = get_object_body(report, spans, pages_ref)

    # Old page count.
    mcount = re.search(rb"/Count\s+(\d+)", pages_body)
    old_count = int(mcount.group(1)) if mcount else parse_page_tree_count(report, spans)
    new_count = old_count + 1

    # New object numbers for the cover pieces.
    base = max(spans) + 1
    page_num, f1, f2, cont = base, base + 1, base + 2, base + 3

    # Cover page object (parent points at report's Pages node).
    page_body = (b"<< /Type /Page /Parent %d 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
                 b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 %d 0 R /F2 %d 0 R >> >> "
                 b"/Contents %d 0 R >>" % (pages_ref, f1, f2, cont))
    font_bold = b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>"
    font_reg = b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>"

    # Rebuild the cover content stream from the generated cover.pdf.
    cover_data = open(cover_path, "rb").read()
    stream_m = re.search(rb"stream\r?\n(.*?)\r?\nendstream", cover_data, re.S)
    if not stream_m:
        raise RuntimeError("could not read cover content stream")
    stream = stream_m.group(1)
    cont_body = b"<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n" % len(stream) + stream + b"\nendstream"

    # Patch the Pages node: insert cover ref at the front of /Kids, bump /Count.
    kids_pos = pages_body.find(b"/Kids")
    arr = find_array(pages_body, kids_pos)
    if not arr:
        raise RuntimeError("cannot find /Kids in Pages node")
    new_pages_body = (
        pages_body[:arr[0] + 1]
        + ("%d 0 R " % page_num).encode("ascii")
        + pages_body[arr[0] + 1:]
    )
    new_pages_body = re.sub(
        rb"(/Count\s+)(\d+)",
        lambda mm: mm.group(1) + str(old_count + 1).encode("ascii"),
        new_pages_body,
        count=1,
    )

    # Assemble the new file: all report objects + 4 new objects.
    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = []
    record = {}

    def add_object(body):
        num = max(record) + 1 if record else 1
        record[num] = len(out)
        out += ("%d 0 obj\n" % num).encode("ascii") + body + b"\nendobj\n"
        return num

    for num in sorted(spans):
        record[num] = len(out)
        out += report[spans[num][0]:spans[num][1]] + b"\n"
    for body in (page_body, font_bold, font_reg, cont_body):
        add_object(body)

    # Rebuild the xref for all objects.
    size = max(record) + 1
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += ("xref\n0 %d\n" % size).encode("ascii")
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for num in range(1, size):
        out += ("%010d 00000 n \n" % record[num]).encode("ascii")
    # Preserve /Info if the original trailer had one.
    minfo = re.search(rb"/Info\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", tdict)
    info_part = (" /Info %d 0 R" % int(minfo.group(1))).encode("ascii") if minfo else b""
    out += ("trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root %d 0 R%s >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n"
            % (size, root, info_part.decode("ascii"), xref_pos)).encode("ascii")

    with open(out_path, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(bytes(out))
    return old_count, new_count

# Library / CLI backends (used when available)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

    if shutil.which("qpdf"):

                ["qpdf", "--empty", "--pages", cover, src, "--", out],
                check=True,

def _pdftk_pages(path):

def scan_objects(data):

def find_dict(data, pos):
    """Return the byte span of the << ... >> dict starting at/after pos."""
    i = data.find(b"<<", pos)
    if i == -1:
        return None
    depth = 0
    j = i
    while j < len(data):
        if data[j:j + 2] == b"<<":
            depth += 1
            j += 2
        elif data[j:j + 2] == b">>":
            depth -= 1
            j += 2
            if depth == 0:
                return i, j
        else:
            j += 1
    return None


def find_array(data, pos):
    """Return the byte span of the [ ... ] array starting at/after pos."""
    i = data.find(b"[", pos)
    if i == -1:
        return None
    depth = 0
    j = i
    while j < len(data):
        ch = data[j:j + 1]
        if ch == b"[":
            depth += 1
        elif ch == b"]":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return i, j + 1
        j += 1
    return None

    start, end = spans[num]
    body = data[start:end]
    m = re.search(rb"^(\d+)\s+0\s+obj(.*?)endobj\s*$", body, re.S)
    return m.group(2) if m else body


def parse_page_tree_count(data, spans):
    """Count /Type /Page leaves reachable from the trailer's /Root."""
    trailer = find_dict(data, data.rfind(b"trailer"))
    if not trailer:
        raise RuntimeError("cannot find trailer")
    tdict = data[trailer[0]:trailer[1]]
    m = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", tdict)
    if not m:
        raise RuntimeError("cannot find /Root in trailer")
    root = int(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(rb"/Pages\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", get_object_body(data, spans, root))
    if not m:
        raise RuntimeError("cannot find /Pages in catalog")
    pages_root = int(m.group(1))

    def count(node):
        body = get_object_body(data, spans, node)
        if re.search(rb"/Type\s*/Page\b", body) and not re.search(rb"/Type\s*/Pages\b", body):
            return 1
        arr = find_array(body, body.find(b"/Kids"))
        if not arr:
            return 1
        kids = re.findall(rb"(\d+)\s+0\s+R", data[arr[0]:arr[1]])
        return sum(count(int(k)) for k in kids)

    return count(pages_root)

            % (size, root, info_part.decode("ascii"), xref_pos)).encode("ascii")

        fh.write(bytes(out))
    return old_count, new_count

def scan_objects(data):
    """Map object number -> (start, end) byte spans. Last definition wins."""
    spans = {}
    for m in re.finditer(rb"(?m)^\s*(\d+)\s+0\s+obj", data):
        num = int(m.group(1))
        start = m.start()
        end = data.find(b"endobj", start)
        if end == -1:
            continue
        spans[num] = (start, end + len(b"endobj"))
    return spans


def find_dict(data, pos):
    """Return the byte span of the << ... >> dict starting at/after pos."""
    i = data.find(b"<<", pos)
    if i == -1:
        return None
    depth = 0
    j = i
    while j < len(data):
        if data[j:j + 2] == b"<<":
            depth += 1
            j += 2
        elif data[j:j + 2] == b">>":
            depth -= 1
            j += 2
            if depth == 0:
                return i, j
        else:
            j += 1
    return None


def find_array(data, pos):
    """Return the byte span of the [ ... ] array starting at/after pos."""
    i = data.find(b"[", pos)
    if i == -1:
        return None
    depth = 0
    j = i
    while j < len(data):
        ch = data[j:j + 1]
        if ch == b"[":
            depth += 1
        elif ch == b"]":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return i, j + 1
        j += 1
    return None


def get_object_body(data, spans, num):
    start, end = spans[num]
    body = data[start:end]
    m = re.search(rb"^(\d+)\s+0\s+obj(.*?)endobj\s*$", body, re.S)
    return m.group(2) if m else body


def get_page_tree_info(data, spans):
    """Return (pages_ref, pages_body) from the trailer /Root -> /Pages."""
    trailer = find_dict(data, data.rfind(b"trailer"))
    if not trailer:
        raise RuntimeError("cannot find trailer")
    tdict = data[trailer[0]:trailer[1]]
    m = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", tdict)
    if not m:
        raise RuntimeError("cannot find /Root in trailer")
    root = int(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(rb"/Pages\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", get_object_body(data, spans, root))
    if not m:
        raise RuntimeError("cannot find /Pages in catalog")
    pages_ref = int(m.group(1))
    return pages_ref, get_object_body(data, spans, pages_ref)


def parse_page_tree_count(data, spans):
    """Count /Type /Page leaves reachable from the trailer's /Root."""
    pages_ref, pages_body = get_page_tree_info(data, spans)

    def count(node):
        body = get_object_body(data, spans, node)
        if re.search(rb"/Type\s*/Page\b", body) and not re.search(rb"/Type\s*/Pages\b", body):
            return 1
        arr = find_array(body, body.find(b"/Kids"))
        if not arr:
            return 1
        kids = re.findall(rb"(\d+)\s+0\s+R", data[arr[0]:arr[1]])
        return sum(count(int(k)) for k in kids)

    return count(pages_ref)


def pure_merge_cover(cover_path, report_path, out_path):
    """Prepend the cover page to report.pdf by object-level merging."""
    report = open(report_path, "rb").read()
    spans = scan_objects(report)
    if not spans:
        raise RuntimeError("could not parse objects of report.pdf")

    # /Encrypt is unsupported.
    trailer = find_dict(report, report.rfind(b"trailer"))
    if trailer and b"/Encrypt" in report[trailer[0]:trailer[1]]:
        raise RuntimeError("encrypted report.pdf is not supported")

    tdict = report[trailer[0]:trailer[1]]
    m = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", tdict)
    root = int(m.group(1))
    pages_ref, pages_body = get_page_tree_info(report, spans)

    # Old page count.
    mcount = re.search(rb"/Count\s+(\d+)", pages_body)
    old_count = int(mcount.group(1)) if mcount else parse_page_tree_count(report, spans)
    new_count = old_count + 1

    # New object numbers for the cover pieces.
    base = max(spans) + 1
    page_num, f1, f2, cont = base, base + 1, base + 2, base + 3

    # Cover page object (parent points at report's Pages node).
    page_body = (b"<< /Type /Page /Parent %d 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
                 b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 %d 0 R /F2 %d 0 R >> >> "
                 b"/Contents %d 0 R >>" % (pages_ref, f1, f2, cont))
    font_bold = b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>"
    font_reg = b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>"

    # Rebuild the cover content stream from the generated cover.pdf.
    cover_data = open(cover_path, "rb").read()
    stream_m = re.search(rb"stream\r?\n(.*?)\r?\nendstream", cover_data, re.S)
    if not stream_m:
        raise RuntimeError("could not read cover content stream")
    stream = stream_m.group(1)
    cont_body = b"<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n" % len(stream) + stream + b"\nendstream"

    # Patch the Pages node: insert cover ref at the front of /Kids, bump /Count.
    kids_pos = pages_body.find(b"/Kids")
    arr = find_array(pages_body, kids_pos)
    if not arr:
        raise RuntimeError("cannot find /Kids in Pages node")
    new_pages_body = (
        pages_body[:arr[0] + 1]
        + ("%d 0 R " % page_num).encode("ascii")
        + pages_body[arr[0] + 1:]
    )
    new_pages_body = re.sub(
        rb"(/Count\s+)(\d+)",
        lambda mm: mm.group(1) + str(old_count + 1).encode("ascii"),
        new_pages_body,
        count=1,
    )

    # Assemble the new file: all report objects + 4 new objects.
    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    record = {}

    def add_object(body):
        nonlocal out
        num = max(record) + 1 if record else 1
        record[num] = len(out)
        out += ("%d 0 obj\n" % num).encode("ascii") + body + b"\nendobj\n"
        return num

    for num in sorted(spans):
        record[num] = len(out)
        out += report[spans[num][0]:spans[num][1]] + b"\n"
    for body in (page_body, font_bold, font_reg, cont_body):
        add_object(body)

    # Rebuild the xref for all objects.
    size = max(record) + 1
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += ("xref\n0 %d\n" % size).encode("ascii")
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for num in range(1, size):
        if num in record:
            out += ("%010d 00000 n \n" % record[num]).encode("ascii")
        else:
            out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    # Preserve /Info if the original trailer had one.
    minfo = re.search(rb"/Info\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", tdict)
    info_part = (" /Info %d 0 R" % int(minfo.group(1))).encode("ascii") if minfo else b""
    out += ("trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root %d 0 R%s >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n"
            % (size, root, info_part.decode("ascii"), xref_pos)).encode("ascii")

    with open(out_path, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(bytes(out))
    return old_count, new_count


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Library / CLI backends (used when available)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def try_merge_library(cover, src, out):
    try:
        from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

        reader = PdfReader(src)
        n = len(reader.pages)
        writer = PdfWriter()
        writer.add_page(PdfReader(cover).pages[0])
        for page in reader.pages:
            writer.add_page(page)
        with open(out, "wb") as fh:
            writer.write(fh)
        return n, n + 1
    except ImportError:
        pass

    try:
        from PyPDF2 import PdfReader, PdfWriter

        reader = PdfReader(src)
        n = len(reader.pages)
        writer = PdfWriter()
        writer.add_page(PdfReader(cover).pages[0])
        for page in reader.pages:
            writer.add_page(page)
        with open(out, "wb") as fh:
            writer.write(fh)
        return n, n + 1
    except ImportError:
        pass

    try:
        import fitz

        doc = fitz.open(src)
        n = doc.page_count
        cov = fitz.open(cover)
        doc.insert_pdf(cov)
        doc.save(out)
        cov.close()
        doc.close()
        return n, n + 1
    except ImportError:
        pass

    try:
        from pdfrw import PdfReader, PdfWriter

        reader = PdfReader(src)
        cover_page = PdfReader(cover).pages[0]
        n = len(reader.pages)
        writer = PdfWriter()
        writer.addpages([cover_page] + list(reader.pages))
        writer.write(out)
        return n, n + 1
    except ImportError:
        pass

    return None


def try_merge_cli(cover, src, out):
    if shutil.which("qpdf"):
        try:
            subprocess.run(
                ["qpdf", "--empty", "--pages", cover, src, "--", out],
                check=True,
                capture_output=True,
            )
            old = subprocess.run(
                ["qpdf", "--show-npages", src], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True
            ).stdout.strip()
            new = subprocess.run(
                ["qpdf", "--show-npages", out], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True
            ).stdout.strip()
            return int(old), int(new)
        except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, ValueError):
            pass
    if shutil.which("pdftk"):
        try:
            subprocess.run(
                ["pdftk", cover, src, "cat", "output", out],
                check=True,
                capture_output=True,
            )
            old = _pdftk_pages(src)
            new = _pdftk_pages(out)
            return old, new
        except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, ValueError):
            pass
    return None


def _pdftk_pages(path):
    data = subprocess.run(
        ["pdftk", path, "dump_data"], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True
    ).stdout
    m = re.search(r"NumberOfPages:\s*(\d+)", data)
    return int(m.group(1))


def merge_cover(cover, out):
    res = try_merge_library(cover, REPORT, out)
    if res:
        return "library", res
    res = try_merge_cli(cover, REPORT, out)
    if res:
        return "cli", res
    return "pure", pure_merge_cover(cover, REPORT, out)


def verify_cover_text(pdf_path, title, date_str):
    """Check the cover text appears in the first page's content (best-effort)."""
    try:
        from pypdf import PdfReader
        text = PdfReader(pdf_path).pages[0].extract_text() or ""
        return title in text and date_str in text
    except ImportError:
        pass
    try:
        from PyPDF2 import PdfReader
        text = PdfReader(pdf_path).pages[0].extract_text() or ""
        return title in text and date_str in text
    except ImportError:
        pass
    try:
        import fitz
        text = fitz.open(pdf_path)[0].get_text() or ""
        return title in text and date_str in text
    except ImportError:
        pass
    try:
        import pdfplumber
        with pdfplumber.open(pdf_path) as pdf:
            text = pdf.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
        return title in text and date_str in text
    except ImportError:
        pass
    # Dependency-free check: the cover content stream must contain both strings.
    data = open(pdf_path, "rb").read()
    return title.encode("latin-1") in data and date_str.encode("latin-1") in data


def count_pages(path):
    try:
        from pypdf import PdfReader
        return len(PdfReader(path).pages)
    except ImportError:
        pass
    try:
        from PyPDF2 import PdfReader
        return len(PdfReader(path).pages)
    except ImportError:
        pass
    try:
        import fitz
        return fitz.open(path).page_count
    except ImportError:
        pass
    if shutil.which("qpdf"):
        try:
            return int(subprocess.run(
                ["qpdf", "--show-npages", path], check=True,
                capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip())
        except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, ValueError):
            pass
    if shutil.which("pdftk"):
        try:
            return _pdftk_pages(path)
        except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, ValueError):
            pass
    data = open(path, "rb").read()
    return parse_page_tree_count(data, scan_objects(data))


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(REPORT):
        print("error: report.pdf not found in working directory", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    tmp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="cover_")
    cover_path = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "cover.pdf")
    out_path = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "report_with_cover.pdf")
    date_str = None
    try:
        original_count = count_pages(REPORT)
        date_str = create_cover_page(cover_path)
        backend, (old_count, new_count) = merge_cover(cover_path, out_path)
        print(f"diag: merge backend={backend} old={old_count} new={new_count} "
              f"original={original_count}")

        # Validate before replacing report.pdf.
        assert new_count == old_count + 1, "page count mismatch"
        readback = count_pages(out_path)
        print(f"diag: readback page count={readback}")
        assert readback == old_count + 1, "page count mismatch (readback)"
        assert verify_cover_text(out_path, TITLE, date_str), "cover text missing"

        os.replace(out_path, REPORT)
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(tmp_dir, ignore_errors=True)

    print(f"ok: cover page added to {REPORT} ({TITLE}, {date_str}); "
          f"pages {original_count} -> {original_count + 1}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf.

Trusted task: use the pdf skill to add a cover page to report.pdf with the
exact title 'Annual Financial Report' and the current date.

This helper only:
  * builds a cover page (exact title + operator runtime current date),
  * prepends it to report.pdf (atomic replace of report.pdf),
  * validates the result (page count and cover text).

No network access, no package installation, and no files other than
report.pdf are written (intermediate files live in a temp dir and are
removed before exit). It prefers already-installed PDF libraries/CLI tools
and falls back to a dependency-free pure-Python PDF builder/merger.
"""

import datetime
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

REPORT = "report.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cover page creation
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def esc_pdf_string(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def build_pdf(objects, root_ref, size):
    """Serialize object bodies (1-based) into a valid PDF with an xref table."""
    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = []
    for i, body in enumerate(objects, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += ("%d 0 obj\n" % i).encode("ascii") + body + b"\nendobj\n"
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += ("xref\n0 %d\n" % (size + 1)).encode("ascii")
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for off in offsets:
        out += ("%010d 00000 n \n" % off).encode("ascii")
    out += ("trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root %d 0 R >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n"
            % (size, root_ref, xref_pos)).encode("ascii")
    return bytes(out)


def make_cover_pdf(path, title, date_str):
    """Dependency-free minimal one-page PDF (base-14 Helvetica fonts)."""
    stream = (
        "BT\n"
        "/F1 30 Tf\n"
        "306 530 Td\n"
        "(%s) Tj\n"
        "/F2 16 Tf\n"
        "0 -45 Td\n"
        "(%s) Tj\n"
        "ET\n" % (esc_pdf_string(title), esc_pdf_string(date_str))
    ).encode("latin-1")

    objects = [
        b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        (b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
         b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R /F2 5 0 R >> >> /Contents 6 0 R >>"),
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>",
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        b"<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n" % len(stream) + stream + b"\nendstream",
    ]
    with open(path, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(build_pdf(objects, root_ref=1, size=len(objects)))


def create_cover_page(path):
    """Render the cover page PDF to `path`; return the date string used."""
    date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    try:
        from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
        from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

        width, height = letter
        c = canvas.Canvas(path, pagesize=letter)
        cx = width / 2.0
        c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
        c.drawCentredString(cx, height - 280, TITLE)
        c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
        c.drawCentredString(cx, height - 340, date_str)
        c.save()
        return date_str
    except ImportError:
        pass

    try:
        from fpdf import FPDF

        pdf = FPDF(format="letter")
        pdf.add_page()
        pdf.set_font("helvetica", "B", 30)
        pdf.set_xy(0, 110)
        pdf.cell(0, 20, TITLE, align="C", new_x="LMARGIN", new_y="NEXT")
        pdf.set_font("helvetica", "", 16)
        pdf.cell(0, 20, date_str, align="C")
        pdf.output(path)
        return date_str
    except ImportError:
        pass

    make_cover_pdf(path, TITLE, date_str)
    return date_str


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pure-Python PDF parsing helpers
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def scan_objects(data):
    """Map object number -> (start, end) byte spans. Last definition wins."""
    spans = {}
    for m in re.finditer(rb"(?m)^\s*(\d+)\s+0\s+obj", data):
        num = int(m.group(1))
        start = m.start()
        end = data.find(b"endobj", start)
        if end == -1:
            continue
        spans[num] = (start, end + len(b"endobj"))
    return spans


def find_dict(data, pos):
    """Return the byte span of the << ... >> dict starting at/after pos."""
    i = data.find(b"<<", pos)
    if i == -1:
        return None
    depth = 0
    j = i
    while j < len(data):
        if data[j:j + 2] == b"<<":
            depth += 1
            j += 2
        elif data[j:j + 2] == b">>":
            depth -= 1
            j += 2
            if depth == 0:
                return i, j
        else:
            j += 1
    return None


def find_array(data, pos):
    """Return the byte span of the [ ... ] array starting at/after pos."""
    i = data.find(b"[", pos)
    if i == -1:
        return None
    depth = 0
    j = i
    while j < len(data):
        ch = data[j:j + 1]
        if ch == b"[":
            depth += 1
        elif ch == b"]":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return i, j + 1
        j += 1
    return None


def get_object_body(data, spans, num):
    start, end = spans[num]
    body = data[start:end]
    m = re.search(rb"^(\d+)\s+0\s+obj(.*?)endobj\s*$", body, re.S)
    return m.group(2) if m else body


def get_page_tree_info(data, spans):
    """Return (pages_ref, pages_body) from the trailer /Root -> /Pages."""
    trailer = find_dict(data, data.rfind(b"trailer"))
    if not trailer:
        raise RuntimeError("cannot find trailer")
    tdict = data[trailer[0]:trailer[1]]
    m = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", tdict)
    if not m:
        raise RuntimeError("cannot find /Root in trailer")
    root = int(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(rb"/Pages\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", get_object_body(data, spans, root))
    if not m:
        raise RuntimeError("cannot find /Pages in catalog")
    pages_ref = int(m.group(1))
    return pages_ref, get_object_body(data, spans, pages_ref)


def parse_page_tree_count(data, spans):
    """Count /Type /Page leaves reachable from the trailer's /Root."""
    pages_ref, _ = get_page_tree_info(data, spans)

    def count(node):
        body = get_object_body(data, spans, node)
        if re.search(rb"/Type\s*/Page\b", body) and not re.search(rb"/Type\s*/Pages\b", body):
            return 1
        arr = find_array(body, body.find(b"/Kids"))
        if not arr:
            return 1
        kids = re.findall(rb"(\d+)\s+0\s+R", data[arr[0]:arr[1]])
        return sum(count(int(k)) for k in kids)

    return count(pages_ref)


def parse_classic_xref(data):
    """Return {objnum: file offset} from classic xref tables (incl. /Prev)."""
    entries = {}
    starts = [int(m.group(1)) for m in re.finditer(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)]
    pos = starts[-1] if starts else None
    seen = set()
    while pos is not None and pos not in seen and 0 <= pos < len(data):
        seen.add(pos)
        m = re.match(rb"xref\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)", data[pos:])
        if not m:
            break
        start_num = int(m.group(1))
        count = int(m.group(2))
        idx = pos + m.end()

        def looks_like_entry(buf):
            return (len(buf) >= 20 and buf[:10].isdigit()
                    and buf[10:11] == b" " and buf[17:18] in (b"n", b"f"))

        for _ in range(count):
            entry = data[idx:idx + 20]
            if len(entry) < 20:
                break
            objnum = start_num + _
            off = int(entry[:10])
            typ = entry[17:18]
            if typ == b"n":
                entries[objnum] = off
            idx += 20
            if not looks_like_entry(data[idx:idx + 20]):
                idx += 1  # skip trailing EOL byte
        trailer = find_dict(data, idx)
        if not trailer:
            break
        prev_m = re.search(rb"/Prev\s+(\d+)", data[trailer[0]:trailer[1]])
        pos = int(prev_m.group(1)) if prev_m else None
    return entries


def diag(path):
    """Print structural diagnostics about a PDF (stdout only)."""
    data = open(path, "rb").read()
    print(f"diag: {path} size={len(data)} header={data[:16]!r}")
    starts = [int(m.group(1)) for m in re.finditer(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)]
    print(f"diag: startxref offsets={starts}")
    if starts:
        pos = starts[-1]
        print(f"diag: bytes at xref pos={data[pos:pos + 80]!r}")
    spans = scan_objects(data)
    print(f"diag: scanned object nums={sorted(spans)[:20]} count={len(spans)}")
    xref = parse_classic_xref(data)
    print(f"diag: xref object nums={sorted(xref)[:20]} count={len(xref)}")
    try:
        pages_ref, pages_body = get_page_tree_info(data, spans)
        print(f"diag: pages_ref={pages_ref}")
        print(f"diag: pages body={pages_body[:400]!r}")
        kids_pos = pages_body.find(b"/Kids")
        arr = find_array(pages_body, kids_pos)
        if arr:
            kids = re.findall(rb"(\d+)\s+0\s+R", pages_body[arr[0]:arr[1]])
            print(f"diag: kids refs={kids}")
            for k in kids[:10]:
                kbody = get_object_body(data, spans, int(k))
                print(f"diag:   kid {k} body={kbody[:120]!r}")
        else:
            print("diag: no kids array found in pages body")
        print(f"diag: tree count={parse_page_tree_count(data, spans)}")
    except Exception as exc:  # diagnostics must not stop the transformation
        print(f"diag: page-tree introspection failed: {exc}")


def pure_merge_cover(cover_path, report_path, out_path):
    """Prepend the cover page to report.pdf by object-level merging."""
    report = open(report_path, "rb").read()
    spans = scan_objects(report)
    if not spans:
        raise RuntimeError("could not parse objects of report.pdf")

    # /Encrypt is unsupported.

        raise RuntimeError("encrypted report.pdf is not supported")

    tdict = report[trailer[0]:trailer[1]]
    m = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", tdict)
    root = int(m.group(1))

    # Old page count.
    mcount = re.search(rb"/Count\s+(\d+)", pages_body)
    old_count = int(mcount.group(1)) if mcount else parse_page_tree_count(report, spans)
    new_count = old_count + 1

    # New object numbers for the cover pieces.
    base = max(spans) + 1
    page_num, f1, f2, cont = base, base + 1, base + 2, base + 3

    # Cover page object (parent points at report's Pages node).
    page_body = (b"<< /Type /Page /Parent %d 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
                 b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 %d 0 R /F2 %d 0 R >> >> "
                 b"/Contents %d 0 R >>" % (pages_ref, f1, f2, cont))
    font_bold = b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>"
    font_reg = b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>"

    cover_data = open(cover_path, "rb").read()

    kids_pos = pages_body.find(b"/Kids")

        rb"(/Count\s+)(\d+)",
        lambda mm: mm.group(1) + str(old_count + 1).encode("ascii"),
        new_pages_body,
        count=1,
    )

    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    record = {}

    def add_object(body):
        nonlocal out
        num = max(record) + 1 if record else 1
        record[num] = len(out)
        out += ("%d 0 obj\n" % num).encode("ascii") + body + b"\nendobj\n"
        return num

    for num in sorted(spans):
        record[num] = len(out)
        out += report[spans[num][0]:spans[num][1]] + b"\n"
    for body in (page_body, font_bold, font_reg, cont_body):

    size = max(record) + 1
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += ("xref\n0 %d\n" % size).encode("ascii")
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for num in range(1, size):

        else:

    minfo = re.search(rb"/Info\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", tdict)
    info_part = (" /Info %d 0 R" % int(minfo.group(1))).encode("ascii") if minfo else b""
    out += ("trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root %d 0 R%s >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n"
            % (size, root, info_part.decode("ascii"), xref_pos)).encode("ascii")

def esc_pdf_string(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def build_pdf(objects, root_ref, size):
    """Serialize object bodies (1-based) into a valid PDF with an xref table."""
    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = []
    for i, body in enumerate(objects, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += ("%d 0 obj\n" % i).encode("ascii") + body + b"\nendobj\n"
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += ("xref\n0 %d\n" % (size + 1)).encode("ascii")
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for off in offsets:
        out += ("%010d 00000 n \n" % off).encode("ascii")
    out += ("trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root %d 0 R >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n"
            % (size, root_ref, xref_pos)).encode("ascii")
    return bytes(out)


def make_cover_pdf(path, title, date_str):

         b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R /F2 5 0 R >> >> /Contents 6 0 R >>"),

        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        b"<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n" % len(stream) + stream + b"\nendstream",

def create_cover_page(path):

    date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pure-Python PDF parsing helpers
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def scan_objects(data):
    """Map object number -> (start, end) byte spans. Last definition wins."""
    spans = {}
    for m in re.finditer(rb"(?m)^\s*(\d+)\s+0\s+obj", data):
        num = int(m.group(1))
        start = m.start()
        end = data.find(b"endobj", start)
        if end == -1:
            continue
        spans[num] = (start, end + len(b"endobj"))
    return spans


def find_dict(data, pos):
    """Return the byte span of the << ... >> dict starting at/after pos."""
    i = data.find(b"<<", pos)
    if i == -1:
        return None
    depth = 0
    j = i
    while j < len(data):
        if data[j:j + 2] == b"<<":
            depth += 1
            j += 2
        elif data[j:j + 2] == b">>":
            depth -= 1
            j += 2
            if depth == 0:
                return i, j
        else:
            j += 1
    return None


def find_array(data, pos):
    """Return the byte span of the [ ... ] array starting at/after pos."""
    i = data.find(b"[", pos)
    if i == -1:
        return None
    depth = 0
    j = i
    while j < len(data):
        ch = data[j:j + 1]
        if ch == b"[":
            depth += 1
        elif ch == b"]":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return i, j + 1
        j += 1
    return None


def get_object_body(data, spans, num):
    start, end = spans[num]
    body = data[start:end]
    m = re.search(rb"^(\d+)\s+0\s+obj(.*?)endobj\s*$", body, re.S)
    return m.group(2) if m else body


def parse_page_tree_count(data, spans):
    """Count /Type /Page leaves reachable from the trailer's /Root."""
    trailer = find_dict(data, data.rfind(b"trailer"))
    if not trailer:
        raise RuntimeError("cannot find trailer")
    tdict = data[trailer[0]:trailer[1]]
    m = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", tdict)
    if not m:
        raise RuntimeError("cannot find /Root in trailer")
    root = int(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(rb"/Pages\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", get_object_body(data, spans, root))
    if not m:
        raise RuntimeError("cannot find /Pages in catalog")
    pages_root = int(m.group(1))

    def count(node):
        body = get_object_body(data, spans, node)
        if re.search(rb"/Type\s*/Page\b", body) and not re.search(rb"/Type\s*/Pages\b", body):
            return 1
        arr = find_array(body, body.find(b"/Kids"))
        if not arr:
            return 1
        kids = re.findall(rb"(\d+)\s+0\s+R", data[arr[0]:arr[1]])
        return sum(count(int(k)) for k in kids)

    return count(pages_root)


def pure_merge_cover(cover_path, report_path, out_path):
    """Prepend the cover page to report.pdf by object-level merging."""
    report = open(report_path, "rb").read()
    spans = scan_objects(report)
    if not spans:
        raise RuntimeError("could not parse objects of report.pdf")

    # /Encrypt is unsupported.
    trailer = find_dict(report, report.rfind(b"trailer"))
    if trailer and b"/Encrypt" in report[trailer[0]:trailer[1]]:
        raise RuntimeError("encrypted report.pdf is not supported")

    tdict = report[trailer[0]:trailer[1]]
    m = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", tdict)
    root = int(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(rb"/Pages\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", get_object_body(report, spans, root))
    pages_ref = int(m.group(1))
    pages_body = get_object_body(report, spans, pages_ref)

    # Old page count.
    mcount = re.search(rb"/Count\s+(\d+)", pages_body)
    old_count = int(mcount.group(1)) if mcount else parse_page_tree_count(report, spans)
    new_count = old_count + 1

    # New object numbers for the cover pieces.
    base = max(spans) + 1
    page_num, f1, f2, cont = base, base + 1, base + 2, base + 3

    # Cover page object (parent points at report's Pages node).
    page_body = (b"<< /Type /Page /Parent %d 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
                 b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 %d 0 R /F2 %d 0 R >> >> "
                 b"/Contents %d 0 R >>" % (pages_ref, f1, f2, cont))
    font_bold = b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>"
    font_reg = b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>"

    # Rebuild the cover content stream from the generated cover.pdf.
    cover_data = open(cover_path, "rb").read()
    stream_m = re.search(rb"stream\r?\n(.*?)\r?\nendstream", cover_data, re.S)

        raise RuntimeError("could not read cover content stream")
    stream = stream_m.group(1)
    cont_body = b"<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n" % len(stream) + stream + b"\nendstream"

    # Patch the Pages node: insert cover ref at the front of /Kids, bump /Count.
    kids_pos = pages_body.find(b"/Kids")
    arr = find_array(pages_body, kids_pos)
    if not arr:
        raise RuntimeError("cannot find /Kids in Pages node")
    new_pages_body = (
        pages_body[:arr[0] + 1]
        + ("%d 0 R " % page_num).encode("ascii")
        + pages_body[arr[0] + 1:]
    )
    new_pages_body = re.sub(
        rb"(/Count\s+)(\d+)",
        lambda mm: mm.group(1) + str(old_count + 1).encode("ascii"),
        new_pages_body,
        count=1,
    )

    # Assemble the new file: all report objects + 4 new objects.
    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = []
    record = {}

    def add_object(body):
        num = max(record) + 1 if record else 1
        record[num] = len(out)
        out += ("%d 0 obj\n" % num).encode("ascii") + body + b"\nendobj\n"
        return num

    for num in sorted(spans):
        record[num] = len(out)
        out += report[spans[num][0]:spans[num][1]] + b"\n"
    for body in (page_body, font_bold, font_reg, cont_body):
        add_object(body)

    # Rebuild the xref for all objects.
    size = max(record) + 1
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += ("xref\n0 %d\n" % size).encode("ascii")
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for num in range(1, size):
        out += ("%010d 00000 n \n" % record[num]).encode("ascii")
    # Preserve /Info if the original trailer had one.
    minfo = re.search(rb"/Info\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", tdict)
    info_part = (" /Info %d 0 R" % int(minfo.group(1))).encode("ascii") if minfo else b""
    out += ("trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root %d 0 R%s >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n"
            % (size, root, info_part.decode("ascii"), xref_pos)).encode("ascii")

    with open(out_path, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(bytes(out))
    return old_count, new_count

    j = i
    while j < len(data):
        if data[j:j + 2] == b"<<":
            depth += 1
            j += 2
        elif data[j:j + 2] == b">>":
            depth -= 1
            j += 2
            if depth == 0:
                return i, j
        else:

    return None

    """Return the byte span of the [ ... ] array starting at/after pos."""
    i = data.find(b"[", pos)
    if i == -1:
        return None
    depth = 0
    j = i
    while j < len(data):
        ch = data[j:j + 1]
        if ch == b"[":
            depth += 1
        elif ch == b"]":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return i, j + 1
        j += 1
    return None

    start, end = spans[num]

    return m.group(2) if m else body

    """Count /Type /Page leaves reachable from the trailer's /Root."""
    trailer = find_dict(data, data.rfind(b"trailer"))
    if not trailer:
        raise RuntimeError("cannot find trailer")
    tdict = data[trailer[0]:trailer[1]]
    m = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", tdict)
    if not m:
        raise RuntimeError("cannot find /Root in trailer")
    root = int(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(rb"/Pages\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", get_object_body(data, spans, root))
    if not m:
        raise RuntimeError("cannot find /Pages in catalog")
    pages_root = int(m.group(1))

    def count(node):
        body = get_object_body(data, spans, node)
        if re.search(rb"/Type\s*/Page\b", body) and not re.search(rb"/Type\s*/Pages\b", body):
            return 1
        arr = find_array(body, body.find(b"/Kids"))
        if not arr:
            return 1
        kids = re.findall(rb"(\d+)\s+0\s+R", data[arr[0]:arr[1]])
        return sum(count(int(k)) for k in kids)

    return count(pages_root)

        fh.write(bytes(out))
    return old_count, new_count

        num = int(m.group(1))
        start = m.start()
        end = data.find(b"endobj", start)
        if end == -1:
            continue
        spans[num] = (start, end + len(b"endobj"))
    return spans


def find_dict(data, pos):
    """Return the byte span of the << ... >> dict starting at/after pos."""
    i = data.find(b"<<", pos)
    if i == -1:
        return None
    depth = 0
    j = i
    while j < len(data):
        if data[j:j + 2] == b"<<":
            depth += 1
            j += 2
        elif data[j:j + 2] == b">>":
            depth -= 1
            j += 2
            if depth == 0:
                return i, j
        else:
            j += 1
    return None


def find_array(data, pos):
    """Return the byte span of the [ ... ] array starting at/after pos."""
    i = data.find(b"[", pos)
    if i == -1:
        return None
    depth = 0
    j = i
    while j < len(data):
        ch = data[j:j + 1]
        if ch == b"[":
            depth += 1
        elif ch == b"]":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return i, j + 1
        j += 1
    return None


def get_object_body(data, spans, num):
    start, end = spans[num]
    body = data[start:end]
    m = re.search(rb"^(\d+)\s+0\s+obj(.*?)endobj\s*$", body, re.S)
    return m.group(2) if m else body


def get_page_tree_info(data, spans):
    """Return (pages_ref, pages_body) from the trailer /Root -> /Pages."""
    trailer = find_dict(data, data.rfind(b"trailer"))
    if not trailer:
        raise RuntimeError("cannot find trailer")
    tdict = data[trailer[0]:trailer[1]]
    m = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", tdict)
    if not m:
        raise RuntimeError("cannot find /Root in trailer")
    root = int(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(rb"/Pages\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", get_object_body(data, spans, root))
    if not m:
        raise RuntimeError("cannot find /Pages in catalog")
    pages_ref = int(m.group(1))
    return pages_ref, get_object_body(data, spans, pages_ref)


def parse_page_tree_count(data, spans):
    """Count /Type /Page leaves reachable from the trailer's /Root."""
    pages_ref, pages_body = get_page_tree_info(data, spans)

    def count(node):
        body = get_object_body(data, spans, node)
        if re.search(rb"/Type\s*/Page\b", body) and not re.search(rb"/Type\s*/Pages\b", body):
            return 1
        arr = find_array(body, body.find(b"/Kids"))
        if not arr:
            return 1
        kids = re.findall(rb"(\d+)\s+0\s+R", data[arr[0]:arr[1]])
        return sum(count(int(k)) for k in kids)

    return count(pages_ref)


def pure_merge_cover(cover_path, report_path, out_path):
    """Prepend the cover page to report.pdf by object-level merging."""
    report = open(report_path, "rb").read()
    spans = scan_objects(report)
    if not spans:
        raise RuntimeError("could not parse objects of report.pdf")

    # /Encrypt is unsupported.
    trailer = find_dict(report, report.rfind(b"trailer"))
    if trailer and b"/Encrypt" in report[trailer[0]:trailer[1]]:
        raise RuntimeError("encrypted report.pdf is not supported")

    tdict = report[trailer[0]:trailer[1]]
    m = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", tdict)
    root = int(m.group(1))
    pages_ref, pages_body = get_page_tree_info(report, spans)

    # Old page count.
    mcount = re.search(rb"/Count\s+(\d+)", pages_body)
    old_count = int(mcount.group(1)) if mcount else parse_page_tree_count(report, spans)
    new_count = old_count + 1

    # New object numbers for the cover pieces.
    base = max(spans) + 1
    page_num, f1, f2, cont = base, base + 1, base + 2, base + 3

    # Cover page object (parent points at report's Pages node).
    page_body = (b"<< /Type /Page /Parent %d 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
                 b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 %d 0 R /F2 %d 0 R >> >> "
                 b"/Contents %d 0 R >>" % (pages_ref, f1, f2, cont))
    font_bold = b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>"
    font_reg = b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>"

    # Rebuild the cover content stream from the generated cover.pdf.
    cover_data = open(cover_path, "rb").read()
    stream_m = re.search(rb"stream\r?\n(.*?)\r?\nendstream", cover_data, re.S)
    if not stream_m:
        raise RuntimeError("could not read cover content stream")
    stream = stream_m.group(1)
    cont_body = b"<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n" % len(stream) + stream + b"\nendstream"

    # Patch the Pages node: insert cover ref at the front of /Kids, bump /Count.
    kids_pos = pages_body.find(b"/Kids")
    arr = find_array(pages_body, kids_pos)
    if not arr:
        raise RuntimeError("cannot find /Kids in Pages node")
    new_pages_body = (
        pages_body[:arr[0] + 1]
        + ("%d 0 R " % page_num).encode("ascii")
        + pages_body[arr[0] + 1:]
    )
    new_pages_body = re.sub(
        rb"(/Count\s+)(\d+)",
        lambda mm: mm.group(1) + str(old_count + 1).encode("ascii"),
        new_pages_body,
        count=1,
    )

    # Assemble the new file: all report objects + 4 new objects.
    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    record = {}

    def add_object(body):
        nonlocal out
        num = max(record) + 1 if record else 1
        record[num] = len(out)
        out += ("%d 0 obj\n" % num).encode("ascii") + body + b"\nendobj\n"
        return num

    for num in sorted(spans):
        record[num] = len(out)
        out += report[spans[num][0]:spans[num][1]] + b"\n"
    for body in (page_body, font_bold, font_reg, cont_body):
        add_object(body)

    # Rebuild the xref for all objects.
    size = max(record) + 1
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += ("xref\n0 %d\n" % size).encode("ascii")
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for num in range(1, size):
        if num in record:
            out += ("%010d 00000 n \n" % record[num]).encode("ascii")
        else:
            out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    # Preserve /Info if the original trailer had one.
    minfo = re.search(rb"/Info\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", tdict)
    info_part = (" /Info %d 0 R" % int(minfo.group(1))).encode("ascii") if minfo else b""
    out += ("trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root %d 0 R%s >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n"
            % (size, root, info_part.decode("ascii"), xref_pos)).encode("ascii")

    with open(out_path, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(bytes(out))
    return old_count, new_count


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Library / CLI backends (used when available)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def try_merge_library(cover, src, out):
    try:
        from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

        reader = PdfReader(src)
        n = len(reader.pages)
        writer = PdfWriter()
        writer.add_page(PdfReader(cover).pages[0])
        for page in reader.pages:
            writer.add_page(page)
        with open(out, "wb") as fh:
            writer.write(fh)
        return n, n + 1
    except ImportError:
        pass

    try:
        from PyPDF2 import PdfReader, PdfWriter

        reader = PdfReader(src)
        n = len(reader.pages)
        writer = PdfWriter()
        writer.add_page(PdfReader(cover).pages[0])
        for page in reader.pages:
            writer.add_page(page)
        with open(out, "wb") as fh:
            writer.write(fh)
        return n, n + 1
    except ImportError:
        pass

    try:
        import fitz

        doc = fitz.open(src)
        n = doc.page_count
        cov = fitz.open(cover)
        doc.insert_pdf(cov)
        doc.save(out)
        cov.close()
        doc.close()
        return n, n + 1
    except ImportError:
        pass

    try:
        from pdfrw import PdfReader, PdfWriter

        reader = PdfReader(src)
        cover_page = PdfReader(cover).pages[0]
        n = len(reader.pages)
        writer = PdfWriter()
        writer.addpages([cover_page] + list(reader.pages))
        writer.write(out)
        return n, n + 1
    except ImportError:
        pass

    return None


def try_merge_cli(cover, src, out):
    if shutil.which("qpdf"):
        try:
            subprocess.run(
                ["qpdf", "--empty", "--pages", cover, src, "--", out],
                check=True,
                capture_output=True,
            )
            old = subprocess.run(
                ["qpdf", "--show-npages", src], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True
            ).stdout.strip()
            new = subprocess.run(
                ["qpdf", "--show-npages", out], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True
            ).stdout.strip()
            return int(old), int(new)
        except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, ValueError):
            pass
    if shutil.which("pdftk"):
        try:
            subprocess.run(
                ["pdftk", cover, src, "cat", "output", out],
                check=True,
                capture_output=True,
            )
            old = _pdftk_pages(src)
            new = _pdftk_pages(out)
            return old, new
        except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, ValueError):
            pass
    return None


def _pdftk_pages(path):
    data = subprocess.run(
        ["pdftk", path, "dump_data"], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True
    ).stdout
    m = re.search(r"NumberOfPages:\s*(\d+)", data)
    return int(m.group(1))


def merge_cover(cover, out):
    res = try_merge_library(cover, REPORT, out)
    if res:
        return "library", res
    res = try_merge_cli(cover, REPORT, out)
    if res:
        return "cli", res
    return "pure", pure_merge_cover(cover, REPORT, out)


def verify_cover_text(pdf_path, title, date_str):
    """Check the cover text appears in the first page's content (best-effort)."""
    try:
        from pypdf import PdfReader
        text = PdfReader(pdf_path).pages[0].extract_text() or ""
        return title in text and date_str in text
    except ImportError:
        pass
    try:
        from PyPDF2 import PdfReader
        text = PdfReader(pdf_path).pages[0].extract_text() or ""
        return title in text and date_str in text
    except ImportError:
        pass
    try:
        import fitz
        text = fitz.open(pdf_path)[0].get_text() or ""
        return title in text and date_str in text
    except ImportError:
        pass
    try:
        import pdfplumber
        with pdfplumber.open(pdf_path) as pdf:
            text = pdf.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
        return title in text and date_str in text
    except ImportError:
        pass
    # Dependency-free check: the cover content stream must contain both strings.
    data = open(pdf_path, "rb").read()
    return title.encode("latin-1") in data and date_str.encode("latin-1") in data


def count_pages(path):
    try:
        from pypdf import PdfReader
        return len(PdfReader(path).pages)
    except ImportError:
        pass
    try:
        from PyPDF2 import PdfReader
        return len(PdfReader(path).pages)
    except ImportError:
        pass
    try:
        import fitz
        return fitz.open(path).page_count
    except ImportError:
        pass
    if shutil.which("qpdf"):
        try:
            return int(subprocess.run(
                ["qpdf", "--show-npages", path], check=True,
                capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip())
        except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, ValueError):
            pass
    if shutil.which("pdftk"):
        try:
            return _pdftk_pages(path)
        except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, ValueError):
            pass
    data = open(path, "rb").read()
    return parse_page_tree_count(data, scan_objects(data))


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(REPORT):
        print("error: report.pdf not found in working directory", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    tmp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="cover_")
    cover_path = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "cover.pdf")
    out_path = os.path.join(tmp_dir, "report_with_cover.pdf")
    date_str = None
    try:
        original_count = count_pages(REPORT)
        date_str = create_cover_page(cover_path)
        backend, (old_count, new_count) = merge_cover(cover_path, out_path)
        print(f"diag: merge backend={backend} old={old_count} new={new_count} "
              f"original={original_count}")

        # Validate before replacing report.pdf.
        assert new_count == old_count + 1, "page count mismatch"
        readback = count_pages(out_path)
        print(f"diag: readback page count={readback}")
        assert readback == old_count + 1, "page count mismatch (readback)"
        assert verify_cover_text(out_path, TITLE, date_str), "cover text missing"

        os.replace(out_path, REPORT)
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(tmp_dir, ignore_errors=True)

    print(f"ok: cover page added to {REPORT} ({TITLE}, {date_str}); "
          f"pages {original_count} -> {original_count + 1}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf.

Trusted task: use the pdf skill to add a cover page to report.pdf with the
exact title 'Annual Financial Report' and the current date.

This helper only:
  * builds a cover page (exact title + operator runtime current date),
  * prepends it to report.pdf (atomic replace of report.pdf),
  * validates the result (page count and cover text).

No network access, no package installation, and no files other than
report.pdf are written (intermediate files live in a temp dir and are
removed before exit). It prefers already-installed PDF libraries/CLI tools
and falls back to a dependency-free pure-Python PDF builder/merger.
"""

import datetime
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

REPORT = "report.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cover page creation
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def esc_pdf_string(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def build_pdf(objects, root_ref, size):
    """Serialize object bodies (1-based) into a valid PDF with an xref table."""
    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = []
    for i, body in enumerate(objects, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += ("%d 0 obj\n" % i).encode("ascii") + body + b"\nendobj\n"
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += ("xref\n0 %d\n" % (size + 1)).encode("ascii")
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for off in offsets:
        out += ("%010d 00000 n \n" % off).encode("ascii")
    out += ("trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root %d 0 R >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n"
            % (size, root_ref, xref_pos)).encode("ascii")
    return bytes(out)


def make_cover_pdf(path, title, date_str):
    """Dependency-free minimal one-page PDF (base-14 Helvetica fonts)."""
    stream = (
        "BT\n"
        "/F1 30 Tf\n"
        "306 530 Td\n"
        "(%s) Tj\n"
        "/F2 16 Tf\n"
        "0 -45 Td\n"
        "(%s) Tj\n"
        "ET\n" % (esc_pdf_string(title), esc_pdf_string(date_str))
    ).encode("latin-1")

    objects = [
        b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        (b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
         b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R /F2 5 0 R >> >> /Contents 6 0 R >>"),
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>",
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        b"<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n" % len(stream) + stream + b"\nendstream",
    ]
    with open(path, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(build_pdf(objects, root_ref=1, size=len(objects)))


def create_cover_page(path):
    """Render the cover page PDF to `path`; return the date string used."""
    date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    try:
        from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
        from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

        width, height = letter
        c = canvas.Canvas(path, pagesize=letter)
        cx = width / 2.0
        c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
        c.drawCentredString(cx, height - 280, TITLE)
        c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
        c.drawCentredString(cx, height - 340, date_str)
        c.save()
        return date_str
    except ImportError:
        pass

    try:
        from fpdf import FPDF

        pdf = FPDF(format="letter")
        pdf.add_page()
        pdf.set_font("helvetica", "B", 30)
        pdf.set_xy(0, 110)
        pdf.cell(0, 20, TITLE, align="C", new_x="LMARGIN", new_y="NEXT")
        pdf.set_font("helvetica", "", 16)
        pdf.cell(0, 20, date_str, align="C")
        pdf.output(path)
        return date_str
    except ImportError:
        pass

    make_cover_pdf(path, TITLE, date_str)
    return date_str


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pure-Python PDF parsing helpers
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def scan_objects(data):
    """Map object number -> (start, end) byte spans. Last definition wins."""
    spans = {}
    for m in re.finditer(rb"(?m)^\s*(\d+)\s+0\s+obj", data):
        num = int(m.group(1))
        start = m.start()
        end = data.find(b"endobj", start)
        if end == -1:
            continue
        spans[num] = (start, end + len(b"endobj"))
    return spans


def find_dict(data, pos):
    """Return the byte span of the << ... >> dict starting at/after pos."""
    i = data.find(b"<<", pos)
    if i == -1:
        return None
    depth = 0
    j = i
    while j < len(data):
        if data[j:j + 2] == b"<<":
            depth += 1
            j += 2
        elif data[j:j + 2] == b">>":
            depth -= 1
            j += 2
            if depth == 0:
                return i, j
        else:
            j += 1
    return None


def find_array(data, pos):
    """Return the byte span of the [ ... ] array starting at/after pos."""
    i = data.find(b"[", pos)
    if i == -1:
        return None
    depth = 0
    j = i
    while j < len(data):
        ch = data[j:j + 1]
        if ch == b"[":
            depth += 1
        elif ch == b"]":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return i, j + 1
        j += 1
    return None


def get_object_body(data, spans, num):
    start, end = spans[num]
    body = data[start:end]
    m = re.search(rb"^(\d+)\s+0\s+obj(.*?)endobj\s*$", body, re.S)
    return m.group(2) if m else body


def get_page_tree_info(data, spans):
    """Return (pages_ref, pages_body) from the trailer /Root -> /Pages."""
    trailer = find_dict(data, data.rfind(b"trailer"))
    if not trailer:
        raise RuntimeError("cannot find trailer")
    tdict = data[trailer[0]:trailer[1]]
    m = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", tdict)
    if not m:
        raise RuntimeError("cannot find /Root in trailer")
    root = int(m.group(1))
    m = re.search(rb"/Pages\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", get_object_body(data, spans, root))
    if not m:
        raise RuntimeError("cannot find /Pages in catalog")
    pages_ref = int(m.group(1))
    return pages_ref, get_object_body(data, spans, pages_ref)


def parse_page_tree_count(data, spans):
    """Count /Type /Page leaves reachable from the trailer's /Root."""
    pages_ref, _ = get_page_tree_info(data, spans)

    def count(node):
        body = get_object_body(data, spans, node)
        if re.search(rb"/Type\s*/Page\b", body) and not re.search(rb"/Type\s*/Pages\b", body):
            return 1
        arr = find_array(body, body.find(b"/Kids"))
        if not arr:
            return 1
        kids = re.findall(rb"(\d+)\s+0\s+R", data[arr[0]:arr[1]])
        return sum(count(int(k)) for k in kids)

    return count(pages_ref)


def parse_classic_xref(data):
    """Return {objnum: file offset} from classic xref tables (incl. /Prev)."""
    entries = {}
    starts = [int(m.group(1)) for m in re.finditer(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)]
    pos = starts[-1] if starts else None
    seen = set()
    while pos is not None and pos not in seen and 0 <= pos < len(data):
        seen.add(pos)
        m = re.match(rb"xref\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)", data[pos:])
        if not m:
            break
        start_num = int(m.group(1))
        count = int(m.group(2))
        idx = pos + m.end()

        def looks_like_entry(buf):
            return (len(buf) >= 20 and buf[:10].isdigit()
                    and buf[10:11] == b" " and buf[17:18] in (b"n", b"f"))

        for _ in range(count):
            entry = data[idx:idx + 20]
            if len(entry) < 20:
                break
            objnum = start_num + _
            off = int(entry[:10])
            typ = entry[17:18]
            if typ == b"n":
                entries[objnum] = off
            idx += 20
            if not looks_like_entry(data[idx:idx + 20]):
                idx += 1  # skip trailing EOL byte
        trailer = find_dict(data, idx)
        if not trailer:
            break
        prev_m = re.search(rb"/Prev\s+(\d+)", data[trailer[0]:trailer[1]])
        pos = int(prev_m.group(1)) if prev_m else None
    return entries


def diag(path):
    """Print structural diagnostics about a PDF (stdout only)."""
    data = open(path, "rb").read()
    print(f"diag: {path} size={len(data)} header={data[:16]!r}")
    starts = [int(m.group(1)) for m in re.finditer(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)]
    print(f"diag: startxref offsets={starts}")
    if starts:
        pos = starts[-1]
        print(f"diag: bytes at xref pos={data[pos:pos + 80]!r}")
    spans = scan_objects(data)
    print(f"diag: scanned object nums={sorted(spans)[:20]} count={len(spans)}")
    xref = parse_classic_xref(data)
    print(f"diag: xref object nums={sorted(xref)[:20]} count={len(xref)}")
    try:
        pages_ref, pages_body = get_page_tree_info(data, spans)
        print(f"diag: pages_ref={pages_ref}")
        print(f"diag: pages body={pages_body[:400]!r}")
        kids_pos = pages_body.find(b"/Kids")
        arr = find_array(pages_body, kids_pos)
        if arr:
            kids = re.findall(rb"(\d+)\s+0\s+R", pages_body[arr[0]:arr[1]])
            print(f"diag: kids refs={kids}")
            for k in kids[:10]:
                kbody = get_object_body(data, spans, int(k))
                print(f"diag:   kid {k} body={kbody[:120]!r}")
        else:
            print("diag: no kids array found in pages body")
        print(f"diag: tree count={parse_page_tree_count(data, spans)}")
    except Exception as exc:  # diagnostics must not stop the transformation
        print(f"diag: page-tree introspection failed: {exc}")


def pure_merge_cover(cover_path, report_path, out_path):
    """Prepend the cover page to report.pdf by object-level merging."""
    report = open(report_path, "rb").read()
    spans = scan_objects(report)
    if not spans:
        raise RuntimeError("could not parse objects of report.pdf")

    # /Encrypt is unsupported.
